findings.title: No automated tests found
findings.evidence: 2 source files and 0 test files (searched tests/, __tests__/, test_*.py, *_test.py, *.test.*, *.spec.*).
findings.explanation: Without tests there is no fast, repeatable way to know whether a change breaks existing behaviour.
findings.impact: Regressions reach users; refactoring (including fixes from this report) is risky.
findings.remediation: Start with tests for the most critical paths (auth, payments, data writes), using pytest/Vitest.

findings.title: Import '@lib/nonexistent' does not resolve to a file
findings.evidence: src/index.ts:2 imports '@lib/nonexistent', but no matching file exists in the repository.
findings.explanation: Local imports were resolved against the repository's files (including tsconfig path aliases). This one has no target. It may be generated at build time, which is why confidence is medium.
findings.impact: If the file is genuinely missing the application will fail to build or crash at import time.
findings.remediation: Fix the import path, add the missing module, or document the code generation step that creates it.
